description: This file contains utility functions for seeding a database with users, event types, teams, attributes, routing forms, and form responses, primarily for testing or initial setup purposes in a Prisma-based project.

methods.name: createUserAndEventType
methods.description: Creates or updates a user, their password, associated event types, bookings, and credentials in the database.

methods.name: createOAuthClientForUser
methods.description: Creates an OAuth client linked to a user with specified properties.

methods.name: createTeamAndAddUsers
methods.description: Creates a team, adds users to it, and associates event types with the team.

methods.name: seedAttributes
methods.description: Seeds predefined attributes and options for a specified team, assigning random values to team members.

methods.name: seedRoutingForms
methods.description: Creates a routing form with specific routes and fields for a team, if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: seedRoutingFormResponses
methods.description: Generates responses for a seeded routing form, linking them to bookings within a team.
